description: Polish fixes: (Fix 7) keyword search on tasks and notes, (Fix 8) CSV export, (Fix 9) remove miniWeek slice(0,4) cap, (Fix 10) restore task edit/delete on mobile. These are independent of FEAT-001 and FEAT-002 (they do not depend on the richer session data) but are listed last to avoid merge conflicts with the HTML regions touched by earlier FEATs.
steps: Step 1 — CSS: search input styles and mobile task menu fix. In the <style> block, inside the `@media(max-width:480px)` rule, find `.task-menu{display:none}` and REPLACE it with `.task-menu{padding:2px 3px;font-size:14px}`. Then, outside any media query (after the last `.dark` rule, before </style>), add: `.search-bar{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:10px}` `.search-bar input[type=search]{flex:1;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;padding:8px 11px;color:var(--ink);background:white;outline:none;font:inherit}` `.search-bar input[type=search]:focus{border-color:#8eabfa}` `.dark .search-bar input[type=search]{background:#202838;color:var(--ink);border-color:#3a455b}`.

Step 4 — HTML: add CSV export button on Tasks page. In `page-tasks`, in `<div class='welcome-row'>`, next to the existing `<button class='primary' id='tasksAdd'>＋ Add session</button>`, add after it: `<button class='secondary' id='exportCSV'>↓ Export CSV</button>`. Wrap both in `<div style='display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center'>` — but check the actual HTML first. The welcome-row button is a direct child of the welcome-row div. Simply append `<button class='secondary' id='exportCSV' style='margin-left:8px'>↓ Export CSV</button>` as a sibling after the primary button.

Step 5 — JS: update renderTasks() to filter by taskSearch. In `renderTasks()`, after reading `f=$('#taskFilter').value`, also read `const q=($('#taskSearch')?.value||'').toLowerCase().trim()`. Then change the filter to: `.filter(t=>f==='done'?t.done:f==='upcoming'?!t.done:true).filter(t=>!q||t.topic.toLowerCase().includes(q)||(subject(t.subject).name.toLowerCase().includes(q)))`. Wire the live filter: after the `$('#taskFilter').onchange=renderTasks` line, add `$('#taskSearch').addEventListener('input',renderTasks)`.

Step 6 — JS: update renderNotes() to filter by noteSearch. In `renderNotes()`, at the start of the function where the notes array is iterated, add: `const nq=($('#noteSearch')?.value||'').toLowerCase().trim()`. Then filter the notes before mapping: change `[...data.notes].sort(...)` to `[...data.notes].filter(n=>!nq||n.title.toLowerCase().includes(nq)||n.body.toLowerCase().includes(nq)).sort(...)`. Also update the note count text to reflect filtered count vs total: use a filtered variable. Wire the live filter: after the `$('#clearNote').onclick=clearNoteEditor` line, add `$('#noteSearch').addEventListener('input',renderNotes)`.

Step 7 — JS: add exportCSV() function and wire the button. Add a new function `exportCSV()`: build an array of rows, where the header is `['Topic','Subject','Date','Start Time','Duration (min)','Done','Exam','Session Count']`. For each task `t` in `data.tasks`, compute `sessionCount=data.sessions.filter(s=>s.taskId===t.id).length`. Row = `[t.topic, subject(t.subject).name, t.date, t.time, t.duration, t.done?'Yes':'No', t.exam?'Yes':'No', sessionCount]`. Convert to CSV string: escape fields by wrapping each in double-quotes and doubling any internal double-quotes. Set `const blob='data:text/csv;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent('\uFEFF' + rows.map(r=>r.map(v=>'"'+String(v).replace(/"/g,'""')+'"').join(',')).join('\r\n'));`. Create a temporary anchor element, set `href=blob`, `download='study-sessions-'+day()+'.csv'`, click it, then remove it. Wire: after the `$('#taskFilter').onchange` line, add `$('#exportCSV').onclick=exportCSV`.

`. Wire this button by calling `$$('[data-goto]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>switchPage(b.dataset.goto))` — this is already wired globally but re-wire after innerHTML set by calling it again inside renderDashboard after miniWeek is set, or use event delegation instead. Simpler: render the button with `onclick='switchPage("calendar")'` as an inline handler (acceptable for a simple nav link in this single-file app).
acceptance_criteria: Typing in the task search box filters the task list live; combining with the filter dropdown works correctly.
Typing in the note search box filters the notes list live.
Clicking '↓ Export CSV' downloads a .csv file with the correct columns and all task data.
The downloaded CSV opens correctly in Excel/Sheets with UTF-8 BOM.
MiniWeek on dashboard shows up to 6 items; when there are more than 6 a 'and N more →' link appears and navigates to the calendar.
On a 480px viewport, task edit (✎) and delete (×) buttons are visible and clickable (not display:none).
verification: Open Tasks page. Add 3+ sessions. Type a keyword in the search box — list filters live. Change the dropdown filter — combined filter works.
Open Notes page. Add 2+ notes. Type a keyword — notes filter live.
Click '↓ Export CSV'. Confirm a file downloads. Open it and confirm all columns and rows are present.
Open Dashboard. Add 7+ sessions for this week. Confirm the miniWeek shows max 6 and displays 'and N more →' link.
Resize browser to 375px width. Go to Tasks. Confirm the ✎ and × buttons are visible on task rows.
Open DevTools console on each page — no uncaught exceptions.
findings: All 8 steps implemented. Key notes: (1) CSS: .task-menu in @media(max-width:480px) changed from display:none to padding:2px 3px;font-size:14px — task edit/delete buttons are now visible and tappable on mobile. (2) .search-bar CSS added after last .dark rule, before </style>. (3) taskSearch input added in page-tasks between section-head and task-list divs; exportCSV button added as sibling after tasksAdd in welcome-row. (4) noteSearch input added in page-notes between notes-list-head and notesList divs. (5) renderTasks() now reads q from taskSearch (optional-chaining safe) and applies a secondary .filter before .sort. Event listeners for both taskSearch (input) and exportCSV (onclick) wired after $('#taskFilter').onchange=renderTasks. (6) renderNotes() now reads nq from noteSearch, filters data.notes before sort, shows a 'No notes match' empty state, and updates noteCount to reflect filtered/total counts. noteSearch listener wired after $('#clearNote').onclick=clearNoteEditor. (7) exportCSV() function inserted before renderNotes; builds CSV with UTF-8 BOM (\uFEFF JS escape), wraps all fields in double-quotes with double-quote escaping, downloads via temporary anchor element. (8) miniWeek .slice(0,4) changed to .slice(0,6); appends a 'and N more →' inline button with onclick=switchPage('calendar') when weekTasks.length>6. The empty-state ternary structure is preserved: weekTasks.length?<slice chain>+'<div>':<empty div>.
